en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
So you wanna keep a cool head.

Mmhm, I think that's definitely something
you need right now, Shuichi!

C'mon, step right in! I'll hold the door shut
for you, so just relax and freeze your head off!

By the way, did you know tea leaves were
used on livestock's food?

They poured hot water over the tea leaves to
sterilize the food. And that's how we got tea!
Well, all of that's a lie...

Do you think if we ask Kirumi, she'll tell
us the real origin of tea?
I don't even feel like lying right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
